items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Pierron, I think he used to have a brother too play music. Because they used to come across on the ferry all the time at night.

ctx.x: Who all was over there in Algeys when you were a youngster? The musicians?

Who all was over there? That's why the, Pierron, them come from over there. Pierron's come from there? Yeah, Pierron from over there. Pierron, I think he used to have a brother too play music. Because they used to come across on the ferry all the time at night.
